questions.question: Can the platform display prices, star ratings, customer review counts, stock status, or automated price alerts?
questions.known: Policies §2(b) restricts price/availability to Amazon-served dynamic links or Creators API / PA API; §6(t) restricts customer reviews/star ratings to Creators API / PA API; §6(y) prohibits price tracking and price alerting unless agreed by Amazon.
questions.missing: Approved Creators API / PA API credentials (which require qualifying Associates sales thresholds) and any written Amazon agreement for price tracking.
questions.current_answer: Answered by official policy: NO static prices, star ratings, review counts, stock claims, or price-alert features are permitted right now. All four fields remain blank and flagged (FLG-004).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Direct buyers to view live price and availability on Amazon; apply for Creators API / PA API access only after meeting Amazon's qualifying sales requirement, and keep §6(y) price-tracking disabled.

questions.question: Where and how must affiliate compensation be disclosed to satisfy both Amazon and the FTC?
questions.known: Operating Agreement §5 requires the verbatim statement "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." FTC 16 CFR §255.5 and FTC staff FAQ require clear, conspicuous disclosure near recommendations and state that "affiliate link", "buy now", or a hidden "DISCLOSURE" button alone is insufficient.
questions.missing: Nothing missing on static pages; ongoing human check required if social, video, or email channels are added later.
questions.current_answer: Answered and enforced: every page renders the verbatim §5 sentence + plain-language paid-link notice above <main> and again in <footer>, and every product CTA states "Paid link" with rel="sponsored nofollow noopener".
questions.discovery_suggestion: Keep platform/verify_edition.py in CI (.github/workflows/edition-verify.yml) so any future page missing the disclosure strip or rel="sponsored" fails the build.
